clips.title: The story
paras: In southwestern Elwynn, Hogger’s huge claw is sought as proof of his death. Stormwind’s authorities in Goldshire require it for the bounty.

Hogger has terrorized the southern woodlands of Forest's Edge for months. Patrols have failed to stop the brute, and the local garrison cannot corral or subdue him. The Stormwind Army, stretched thin across Elwynn, posted an open bounty on his head. Marshal Dughan in Goldshire requires clear proof before paying it. Hogger's oversized claw leaves no doubt that the notorious marauder has fallen.
